name: @jesscss/less-corpus-fixture-deps
description: Install root for third-party packages that Less corpus fixtures @import by bare specifier. Fixtures live in the read-only less.js checkout and cannot declare their own dependencies, so the jess harness anchors module resolution here (see packages/jess/test/test-utils.ts resolveLessFixtureDepsRoot). Versions are pinned to whatever the maintained .css golden was generated against — do NOT float them.
